confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chinese coastal tier-two city prices, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel rates are less certain because July is peak beach-season demand in Qingdao. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The beer anchor reflects draught at an ordinary restaurant, not a hotel bar.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Chinese coastal tourist cities outside the first-tier cities, such as Xiamen and Dalian. Qingdao's beer-brewing identity and July summer tourism demand are reflected in the beer and accommodation anchors.
